reviewed_exclusions.item: Roseland Community Hospital labor and delivery, Chicago, IL
reviewed_exclusions.reason: CBS Chicago report updated November 1 at 10:10 AM CST, equivalent to 8:10 AM PST, before this run's observation window; maternity closure was already recorded in preceding watches.

source_failures.description: One territory-focused query triggered a non-retryable robots.txt access block; no bypass attempted.

coverage_notes.search_quality: DEGRADED: response sets were dominated by stale, generic or non-US results despite recency filters; territory-focused results had robots.txt source access denials. These limitations materially constrain supplementary recall confidence.
coverage_notes.limitations: Zero findings are not proof that no events occurred; rural/territorial reporting and timing remain non-exhaustive. Older announcements of a November 1 effective date do not, by themselves, establish a newly verified transition during the current window.
coverage_notes.controls: Only one append-only private heartbeat on ops/watch-ledger; no approvals, publishing, schedule change or disablement.
